profile.headline: Platform Lead, Architect
profile.summary: Experienced Software Architect with a demonstrated history of designing and delivering applications and services with modern technologies, with an acute passion for distributed computing and high end software design.

positions.title: Software Architect
positions.description:
Invoicing Re-architecture - With most of the invoicing code split between VB.Net classes, SQL Server stored procedures and batch jobs, the process of reliably generating and delivering invoices was insufficient.  Using the business events we published, we were able to re-architect the invoicing process around a set of autonomous services singularly responsible for generating and delivering invoices.

Matches - Looking to modernize their core internal desktop software, we set out to research what choices we needed to make, including getting help from several design firms.  After settling on what scenario offered the best ROI, we started developing POC's and concepts based on the vetted designs.  

Cisco UCCE/Finesse - With over 1 million calls coming into enterprise, it became important to give their employees additional context into the incoming call.  UCCE offered us the opportunity to capture incoming call XMPP events, using these events we were able to show native Windows 10 Notifications offering our service reps vital information about that person or opportunity, in addition to integration with core desktop applications. 

Speaking - Presented and took questions on Event Publishing in autonomous services, offering insights into our intended road map and how we measured against that, detailing challenges and opportunities.

Writing - Contributed to an internal micro-blog, topics included Autonomous Service Composition and the Outbox pattern, relating these critical topics to potent scenarios and well understood conditions.

Workshop - Lead workshop on asynchronous workflow based Web API's and User Interface autonomy. Discussed techniques to keep UI's/Apps responsive and informed during long running processes, including the varying degrees to which you apply additional infrastructure.  This lead to discussions on client/server acknowledgments and service choreography, orchestration and correlation.
 
Continued on my resume...

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Predator - Contributed to re-platforming of core internal native Windows client application and services, refactoring WPF pages and ViewModels, reducing the lines of code by 65%, and making the application more sustainable and thread context aware.  In addition to procuring Advanced Distributed Systems Design training for the team leads and senior developers, with a specific focus on distributed computing fallacies, Domain Driven Design (DDD) and Event Driven Architectures. 

Event Publishing - Created a service for the publication of meaningful business events, this included a ASP.Net Web API, NServiceBus and RabbitMQ.  Once deployed, it opened the door for other core services to do important work in near real-time reliably.

Durable Email - With so many implementations of sending SMTP messages, I created a service to encapsulate, enrich and make resilient, they way our applications and services sent SMTP based messages.  This included a ASP.Net Web API, NServiceBus service, RabbitMQ and Razor for templates and formatting.

Ping/Pong App - As an architectural sample, I created ping pong applications and services built using UWP, ASP.Net Web API, MSMQ, Rebus, MongoDB and SignalR.  This included a touch screen app for players, services and Windows desktop notifications of game/table events and status.

positions.title: Senior Consultant
positions.description: Motorola Solutions, Schaumburg IL - Senior Engineering Consultant providing development and performance testing services for the Real Time intelligence Console based on .Net, C#, WPF, ArcGIS, MSMQ and WCF.  Collaborating with Senior Architects, Product Management and User Experience on product goals, performance insights and results, with an emphasis on high quality and security.

positions.title: Solutions Architect
positions.description: Solutions Architect - Provided high level technical diagrams for internal and customer applications, while collaborated with UX practitioners and developers, ensuring simplified architectures and delivery, in addition to delivering POC's to technical leads and senior developers.

positions.title: Senior Engineer
positions.description: While working out the office and sales perusing clients, I participated in Microsoft Windows 8 Ranger training and Won Microsoft Surface RT tablet during a Window 8 application development contest!  Participated in Architecture Design Sessions advising perspective clients on Windows 8 design and implementation using XAML/C#, MVVM, IOC and researching UI Composition frameworks

positions.title: Engagement Manager
positions.description:
McDonald's Corporation ITR - Next Generation Customer Kiosk
Managed a 4 person team developing thier next generation self-service kiosk using WPF 3.5, Prism, C#, MVVM, Linq, XML and Sockets, including integration with their vendor provided POS.  Provided techniacal direction, development and testing, including day-to-day client management and project reporting using Visual Studio Team Foundation Server.  

McDonald's Corporation ITR – Hydra
Architected and developed an asynchronous messaged based in-store application display and integration framework based on NServiceBus 2.0, WPF 3.5 SP1, CAG (Prism) and MVVM.  Provided development SDK, including Visual Studio project templates, technical documentation, tutorials and quick start guides.

McDonalds Corporation ITR – Order Ready Board
Based on the Hydra framework we created, designed and developed their international standard order number display system using WPF 3.5 SP1, NServiceBus 2.0, Prism and MVVM.

McDonald's Corporation ITR – Drive Thru Speed of Service
Conducted as an initial research project into Microsoft Azure using Silverlight 5, Azure Queues and Table storage. Traveled to Microsoft for week long customer engagement with the Windows & SQL Azure teams,
learning cloud development patterns and techniques. Re-architected application using messaging patterns to queue storage, utilizing Task Parallel Library and IO completion ports for higher throughput.



Fox Mobile – Bitbop
•  Managed and lead the development of a Windows Phone 7 based media streaming application.

•  Integration with third party content REST API’s and media providers.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
•  Designed and developed .Net Windows Forms, server side frameworks and services that served as the foundation of all .Net based applications.

•  Held workshops on framework and application design, with a focus on API and framework usability.

•  Guided developers in the augmentation of our application framework, paying special attention to programming models and service composition.

•  Established relationships with Microsoft product evangelist, occasionally scheduling product and technology review sessions. 

•  Provided considerable influence in adopting Agile and Iterative software development processes.

•  Customized and implemented Visual Studio Team System CMMI process templates and reports, providing visibility into development process metrics.

•  Led in the delivery of an affordable housing deal front office acquisition and approval workflow application using .Net Windows Forms, our custom framework components, C#, ASP.Net Web Services, SQL Server 2000 and IBatis.Net.

•  Participated in the delivery of back office accounting sub-ledger for bank Energy, Leveraged Leasing and Housing investments utilizing our custom framework, C#, Web Services, SQL Server 2005, SQL Server Reporting Services and IBatis.Net.

•  Led in the delivery of an wind energy deal front office acquisition and approval workflow application using .Net Windows Forms application utilizing the Microsoft Composite Application Block, Smart Client Software Factory, .Net Framework 2.0, our custom framework components, C#, ASP.Net Web Services, SQL Server 2005, SQL Server Reporting Services and IBatis.Net.
